visualDirection.fit: Project home/stage companion, not chibi and not sticker-only.
identity: black cat ears with pale pink inner fur
long black hair with pink ends
black oversized techwear sweater or jacket
avoid: readable logos or UI text in sprite art
detached effects that break cutout cleanup

states.trigger: default online companion state
states.pose: calm breathing, tiny blink, slight hair and ear movement

states.trigger: low-distraction or inactive mode
states.pose: eyes lowered or sleepy, minimal breathing, lower energy

states.trigger: user input is open or the companion is listening
states.pose: slight lean forward, attentive eyes, ears subtly angled toward user

states.trigger: assistant is generating or tool events are running
states.pose: focused gaze, hand near cheek, small pendant or hair sway

states.trigger: assistant is streaming text or TTS is active
states.pose: mouth open and close frames, warm expression, head mostly stable

states.trigger: assistant reply completed
states.pose: soft return-to-idle smile, tiny nod

states.trigger: retrieving diary, memory, or wiki context before reply
states.pose: eyes scanning, focused, pendant/device accent gently lit

states.trigger: relevant memory or citation found
states.pose: small knowing smile, eyes brighten, posture opens

states.trigger: retrieval found no useful prior context
states.pose: gentle unsure look, small head tilt, no dramatic failure

states.trigger: daily chat diary or structured diary saved
states.pose: contented organizing gesture, calm smile

states.trigger: high-value reusable memory is saved automatically
states.pose: careful satisfied expression, hand near pendant or chest

states.trigger: high-risk or low-confidence memory needs user confirmation
states.pose: careful expectant look, palms close, waiting for approval

states.trigger: sensitive credential or privacy guard blocks saving
states.pose: protective composed expression, lowered voice feeling

states.trigger: undo or rollback of a recorded action
states.pose: small apologetic nod, returning a note or closing hands

states.trigger: wiki ingest, synthesize, or summary organization
states.pose: focused sorting posture, eyes down and back up

states.trigger: wiki lint, format check, or self-check
states.pose: inspectful head tilt, precise careful expression

states.trigger: query archive or knowledge page update completed
states.pose: quietly satisfied, relaxed shoulders

states.trigger: new reminder or task is recorded
states.pose: small decisive nod, one hand lifts slightly

states.trigger: reminder fires
states.pose: alert but gentle expression, ears perk up

states.trigger: task is completed
states.pose: small celebration, controlled smile, no large effects

states.trigger: open thread or relationship continuity is detected
states.pose: warm recognition, soft eye contact

states.trigger: comforting, supportive, or emotional companion reply
states.pose: softened expression, slow blink, gentle lean

states.trigger: small success, validation passed, user did well
states.pose: brief restrained cheer, warm smile

states.trigger: sidecar or local service is connecting
states.pose: focused waiting, small rhythmic pendant/device light

states.trigger: backend disconnected
states.pose: quiet offline standby, dimmer eyes, lower ears

states.trigger: failed reply, API error, or blocked operation
states.pose: concerned but not exaggerated, small frown, no red X

states.trigger: diagnostic or validation completes
states.pose: checked and calm, slight nod

states.trigger: desktop pet is dragged right
states.pose: hair and shoulders lag slightly left, character faces right

states.trigger: desktop pet is dragged left
states.pose: hair and shoulders lag slightly right, character faces left

states.trigger: greeting or shortcut reveal
states.pose: small hand wave, no wave marks

states.trigger: waiting for user input, approval, or next step
states.pose: expectant attentive look

states.trigger: reviewing output or completed artifact
states.pose: focused review posture, tiny blink
